#### 1. mild spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia due to COL2A1 mutation with early-onset osteoarthritis  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.789)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-186797, Reactome:R-HSA-198933, Reactome:R-HSA-2022090, Reactome:R-HSA-216083, Reactome:R-HSA-3000171)

Mutations in COL2A1 disrupt the synthesis and assembly of type II collagen, a process critical for cartilage and bone development. This disruption leads to abnormal bone development and cartilage integrity, manifesting as distinct but related phenotypes: Legg-Calve-Perthes disease and spondyloepiphyseal dysplasia with early-onset osteoarthritis.

**How to falsify it:** Discovery of pathogenic variants in COL2A1 with a clear dominant-negative effect or gain-of-function mechanism for either disease would falsify the proposed loss-of-function hypothesis. _(variant: High frequency (>1%) of loss-of-function variants in COL2A1 in general population databases like gnomAD.)_
